card.title: A short survey from {{organization}}
card.body: Five questions about the past two weeks, about {{minutes}} minutes. Voluntary; your employer sees only group results.
card.submitted: Thank you, your answers were submitted on {{date}}.

intro.title: Before you start
intro.lead: {{organization}} asks for your view of the past two weeks. Taking part is voluntary and takes about {{minutes}} minutes.
intro.voluntary: You can stop at any time without answering.
intro.employerSees: Your employer sees only aggregate results for groups of at least {{minimum}} people, never who took part or how anyone answered.
intro.nestselfLink: NestSelf keeps a restricted technical link to your account only to check eligibility, prevent duplicate answers, send at most two reminders and show you your receipt. Your employer never sees it.

submit.title: Review your answers
submit.lead: You can still change an answer. Once submitted, answers cannot be changed.
submit.atLeastOne: Answer at least one question to submit.

receipt.title: Thank you
receipt.body: Your answers were submitted on {{date}}. They are counted once and cannot be changed.
receipt.feedbackBody: You can raise a problem or a suggestion separately. It goes to the people named in the form, never with your survey answers, and nothing is created unless you submit it.

none.title: No survey right now
none.body: When your organization opens a survey, it appears here and in your email.

errors.loadTitle: The survey could not be loaded

overview.title: Listening overview
overview.lead: Five dimensions of the employee experience, measured every cycle. Group results only.
overview.participationHidden: Participation is shown once at least {{minimum}} people have answered
overview.collectingBody: It closes on {{date}}. Results appear after the close; no live scores are shown while people answer.
overview.noResultsBody: The first published cycle will appear here with five dimension cards.
overview.stale: The latest result is more than {{days}} days old
overview.staleBody: It stays visible for reference. A new cycle gives a current picture; no review invitation is shown for an outdated result.
overview.trendFlat: No change since the previous cycle
overview.trendSuppressed: Comparison unavailable: a previous result is hidden
overview.capabilityOff: Measurement is not enabled for your organization.
overview.measurementNote: A favorable percentage is a survey result, not a diagnosis or a cause.

heatmap.title: Departments
heatmap.lead: Fixed score bands by department and dimension. Cells with fewer than {{minimum}} respondents are hidden, and a department is also hidden when showing it would reveal a smaller one.
heatmap.legendBody: Good 75.0% and above, Monitor 60.0% to 74.9%, Needs attention below 60.0%. Gray cells have no displayable score.

dimension.title: {{dimension}}
dimension.question: The question employees answered
dimension.requestReviewBody: Our team can review these results with you, understand the context and prepare proposals. The product does not generate recommendations from a score.

cycles.title: Surveys
cycles.lead: Schedule survey cycles and see their state. You never see who answered.
cycles.noNextLaunch: No automatic launch is scheduled; NestSelf sets the recurring schedule with you.
cycles.audience: {{count}} active members would be invited today
cycles.noQuestionnaire: No published questionnaire is assigned yet.
cycles.cancelBody: Collection and reminders stop. No partial result is published. A published cycle cannot be canceled.
cycles.sampleNote: Sample mode: scheduling and canceling are disabled.

offer.title: {{dimension}} needs attention
offer.body: {{score}}% of responses were favorable in the latest survey.
offer.bodyMany: The latest survey shows {{dimensions}} below the attention threshold.
offer.pitch: Our team can review these results with you, understand the context and prepare proposals for improvement.
offer.dismissed: You dismissed this invitation for the current cycle. The results stay visible.
offer.activeNote: A workplace review is already under way for this organization.

export.failed: The export could not be prepared
export.note: The file holds the same aggregate values as this page, nothing more.

settings.title: Listening settings
settings.lead: What NestSelf has configured for your organization. Changes are made with NestSelf.
settings.freshness: A result counts as current for {{days}} days
settings.loadFailed: The settings could not be loaded

errors.not_eligible: You are not part of this survey's audience.
errors.cycle_closed: This survey is no longer open.
errors.template_version_mismatch: The questionnaire changed. Reload the survey and try again.
errors.measurement_disabled: Measurement is not enabled for this organization.
errors.cycle_overlap: Another cycle is scheduled or open in this period.
errors.no_published_questionnaire: No published questionnaire is assigned to this organization.
errors.forbidden: You do not have access to this.
errors.notFound: This item could not be found.
errors.contextMismatch: Switch to the organization workspace to continue.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.conflict: This action is not possible in the current state.
errors.route_unavailable: This route is not available right now. Choose another recipient or try again later.
errors.feedback_disabled: The feedback channel is not enabled for this organization.
errors.handler_not_eligible: This person is not an active member with the feedback handler grant.
errors.same_handler: The designated and the alternative recipient must be different people.
errors.sensitive_not_enabled: Sensitive reporting is not enabled for this organization.
errors.invalid_state: This change is not possible in the case's current state.

questionnaires.title: Questionnaires
questionnaires.lead: Versions of the five-question survey. The wording is written per language; the keys, the 1 to 5 scale and the scoring never change. A version is published after review and then stays frozen.
questionnaires.newDraftHint: Starts from the latest published wording and stays comparable with it.
questionnaires.sampleNote: Sample mode: drafts are not saved and nothing is published.
questionnaires.publishBody: Employees see this wording in every cycle launched from now on. A published version cannot be edited; changes need a new version.
questionnaires.archiveBody: An archived version cannot be assigned to clients. Published results that used it stay readable.

editor.readOnly: This version is frozen. Create a new draft to change the wording.
editor.comparableHint: The published version this one keeps the same meaning and scale as, so trends continue. Choose none when a question changes meaning.
editor.comparableNone: Not comparable with an earlier version
editor.noticeHint: Shown to every employee before the first question.
editor.question: Question
editor.fillCyrillicDone: The Cyrillic wording was filled from the Latin wording. Check it before saving.
editor.errorsTitle: The draft cannot be saved yet

preview.title: Employee preview
preview.lead: Exactly what an employee reads, in the chosen language and screen size.

clientConfig.title: Listening configuration
clientConfig.lead: Entitlements and reporting rules for this client. Changes apply to future cycles; published results keep the rules they were computed with.
clientConfig.sampleNote: Sample mode: the configuration cannot be changed.
clientConfig.capabilitiesHint: A capability is on between its dates. Leave Until empty for no end date.
clientConfig.sensitiveHint: Lets employees mark a case as sensitive so that only the designated handler sees it.
clientConfig.minimumCohortHint: Never below the platform floor of {{min}}.
clientConfig.thresholdHint: Below Monitor is Danger. Whole numbers or one decimal.
clientConfig.questionnaireHint: Only published versions can be assigned.
clientConfig.nextLaunchHint: Leave empty to stop automatic launches; cycles then start only when the client schedules one. Shown in your browser's time; the client's time zone is {{zone}}.
clientConfig.saved: The configuration was saved. Future cycles use rules version {{version}}.
clientConfig.errorsTitle: The configuration cannot be saved yet

errors.number: Enter a whole number between {{min}} and {{max}}.
errors.window: The response window cannot be longer than the cadence.

feedback.title: Feedback
feedback.lead: Raise a problem or suggest an improvement. The recipient sees a case pseudonym, never your account.
feedback.empty: You have not raised anything yet.
feedback.emptyBody: A report goes to a designated recipient or, if you prefer, to the independent alternative. Nothing here is linked to surveys.

composer.title: Raise a problem or suggestion
composer.lead: Describe what happened or what would help. You choose who receives it and whether your name travels with it.
composer.sampleNote: Sample mode: nothing you write here is sent or saved.
composer.sensitiveNote: This route is monitored {{hours}}. It is not an emergency service.
composer.alternateOption: {{name}} (alternative recipient, if the matter concerns the designated one)
composer.previewAlternate: {{other}} will not receive it and will not be told you chose the alternative.
composer.previewPrimary: {{other}} is the alternative if the designated recipient cannot take it.
composer.anonymousHint: The default. The recipient sees a case pseudonym; your account is never shown to your employer.
composer.anonymousOff: Your name will travel with the report. You can switch this back on.
composer.identityWarning: Details in your text (names, dates, places, your role) can still reveal who you are. Share what the recipient needs and no more.
composer.body: What happened, or what would help?
composer.bodyHint: Up to 5000 characters. No files in the pilot.
composer.whoSees: The recipient you choose, and only them. Not your manager by default, not NestSelf staff, and never the survey reports or exports.
composer.unavailable: The feedback channel is not available
composer.unavailableBody: Your organization has not enabled it or has no designated recipients yet. Ask your HR contact which process applies; NestSelf does not route reports elsewhere.

receipt.title: Your report was received
receipt.body: It is now case {{pseudonym}}, with the {{function}}. The response target is {{date}}.
receipt.bodyNoDue: It is now case {{pseudonym}}, with the {{function}}.
receipt.note: You will be notified by email when there is a reply; the email never contains the content.

case.title: Case {{pseudonym}}
case.replyPlaceholder: Write a reply or ask for clarification
case.failed: Could not send. Your text is kept.
case.closed: This case is closed and accepts no replies.
case.resolvedNote: This case is resolved. Replying reopens it for the recipient.
case.sampleNote: Sample mode: replies are shown here only and not sent.

inbox.title: Feedback inbox
inbox.lead: Cases assigned to you. You see a pseudonym per case, never the reporter's account.
inbox.empty: No cases are assigned to you.
inbox.sampleNote: Sample mode: these cases are fictional and nothing you do here is saved.

handler.title: Case {{pseudonym}}
handler.internalHint: Internal notes are set apart and never shown to the reporter.
handler.messagePlaceholder: Write to the reporter, or an internal note for the case
handler.asInternal: Internal note (not visible to the reporter)
handler.explanationHint: Required to resolve. The reporter reads it as a message.
handler.outcomeReasonHint: Required to close. Not shown to the reporter.
handler.reassignLead: This case can be handed over to the {{function}}; they are notified and take it over.
handler.reassignBody: The {{function}} takes over the case and is notified. You lose access to it.
handler.anonymous: The reporter chose to stay anonymous towards the employer.

errors.explanationRequired: Write the explanation the reporter will read.

recipients.title: Feedback recipients
recipients.lead: Who receives problems and suggestions. A route needs a designated recipient and an independent alternative, both holding the feedback handler grant, before it is enabled.
recipients.channelOff: The feedback channel is not enabled for your organization. Recipients can be prepared; employees see the channel once NestSelf enables it.
recipients.sensitiveGate: Sensitive reporting is enabled by NestSelf once a staffed process exists: named recipients, an independent alternative, monitored hours and an escalation route. It is never presented as a certified whistleblowing channel.
recipients.sensitiveLocked: Not enabled for your organization. Ask NestSelf once the process is in place.
recipients.categoriesHint: One per line, as employees will see them.
recipients.operatingHoursHint: Shown to employees in the composer, for example "Mon-Fri 9-17".
recipients.escalationNoteHint: Your organization's actual process when the route is unavailable.
recipients.eligibilityNote: Both recipients must be active members holding the feedback handler grant; the server refuses the save otherwise.

errors.target: Enter a whole number of hours between 1 and 720.
